data.one_liner: Renders SVGA animations in Flutter natively using CustomPainter.
data.what_it_does: Decodes and renders SVGA animation files natively within Flutter using CustomPainter. It supports loading from local assets or remote URLs with controllable animation playback and dynamic element modification.
use_when: You need to render SVGA animation formats inside your Flutter application.
You require high-performance, low-cost native rendering using CustomPainter.
avoid_when: You need built-in caching for remote resource files (the library suggests using dio or other libraries for this).
You are using SVGA format versions newer than 2.0.
strengths: Renders animations natively via CustomPainter for high performance.
Supports dynamic elements like replacing bitmaps, adding text, and hiding elements dynamically.
weaknesses: Does not manage any file or resource caches out of the box.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and optionally configure local assets if loading local SVGA files.
